title: RF-DETR (N / S / M / L detection, Seg N to 2XL)
description: Roboflow RF-DETR (N, S, M, L detection; Seg N to 2XL with instance masks; COCO): real-time end-to-end detector with a windowed DINOv2 backbone and deformable decoder, no NMS.…
html:
Roboflow RF-DETR (N, S, M, L detection; Seg N to 2XL with instance masks; COCO): real-time end-to-end detector with a windowed DINOv2 backbone and deformable decoder, no NMS. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: RF-DETR: Neural Architecture Search for Real-Time Detection Transformers, ICLR 2026, 2025-11-12
  • Original code: https://github.com/roboflow/rf-detr at 5b22dfc09406
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/roboflow/rf-detr/blob/5b22dfc0940697ce1abdfa681a5f7392b3eddbfb/README.md#license
  • Training data: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), Objects365 (train, box annotations), LVD-142M (DINOv2's curated web-image set, not released) (COCO 2017 train (README); the RF-DETR paper (arXiv:2511.09554) pretrains detection on Objects365; the DINOv2-small backbone originates from LVD-142M pretraining. Full intermediate training provenance is not stated.)
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.5 (0.0 to 1.0), max_detections = 100 (>= 1)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, fvm_conv
  • Variants: rf-detr-n-coco, rf-detr-s-coco, rf-detr-m-coco, rf-detr-l-coco, rf-detr-seg-n-coco, rf-detr-seg-s-coco, rf-detr-seg-m-coco, rf-detr-seg-l-coco, rf-detr-seg-xl-coco, rf-detr-seg-2xl-coco
  • Outputs: boxes, scores, labels, masks; label_set: coco-80
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): rf-detr-n-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rf-detr-s-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rf-detr-m-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rf-detr-l-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rf-detr-seg-n-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rf-detr-seg-s-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rf-detr-seg-m-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rf-detr-seg-l-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rf-detr-seg-xl-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rf-detr-seg-2xl-coco 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved)

Limitations

  • Requires the optional transformers and torchvision libraries.
  • Only the Apache-2.0 checkpoints are included; the PML-1.0 detection variants (A / F / P / XL / 2XL) are not.
  • torch.compile uses upstream positional-interpolation graph breaks; fullgraph=True is unsupported.
